title: BoundaryLine
description: One line of boundary.jsonl in a session recording, recording_version 1 (docs/session-recording.md): one event or result JavaScript received from the capture module, exactly as it received it. TypeScript writes these lines and hands them to the module (appendBoundary). Checked by validate-recording, not by this schema: seq strictly increases, t never decreases, value parses as JSON, and binary is boundary/<seq>.f32 for this line's seq.

t.description: The session time the module stamped on the event or result.

kind.description: The event's or the call's name, for example onStatus or floorTriangles.

value.description: What JavaScript received, as JSON text, or null when it was binary.

binary.description: boundary/<seq>.f32 (seq zero-padded to six digits) for a binary result, such as floor triangles, else null.
